editorial:
If you enjoy action movies with a soft family side, this one hits a fun sweet spot. Kevin Costner plays Ethan Renner, a tough international spy who is dying of brain cancer and wants to spend his last days reconnecting with his estranged wife and teenage daughter. The catch is that a mysterious handler offers him an experimental drug that could save his life, but only if he completes one last mission to take down a ruthless terrorist known as the Wolf. The real comedy comes from Ethan trying to juggle deadly spy work with everyday dad duties like babysitting his daughter, teaching her to ride a bike, and dealing with her teenage drama. The tone mixes shootouts and car chases with warm, funny family moments, so it never feels too heavy. The Paris setting adds great scenery and gives the whole movie a stylish, energetic vibe.

Costner carries the film with his usual gruff charm, and his chemistry with his on-screen daughter feels genuine and sweet. Amber Heard is fun as the flashy handler Vivi, though her character can feel a bit over the top. The action scenes are solid and easy to follow, with some good fight choreography and a memorable car chase. On the downside, the plot is pretty predictable and the villains are fairly generic, so do not expect deep surprises. Still, if you want a breezy weekend action movie with heart, this is a good pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, Ethan discovers the Wolf is planning a major attack and that his daughter Zoey has been kidnapped by the terrorists. He rushes to save her, fighting through henchmen in a brutal showdown. Ethan kills the Wolf and his right-hand man, rescuing Zoey just in time. The experimental drug causes dangerous hallucinations, but Ethan survives and finally reconciles with his wife Christine and daughter. In the last scene, the family is reunited and happy, and when Vivi calls with another job offer, Ethan smiles and turns it down, choosing family over spy life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action movies with heart and Kevin Costner fans.
